title: Functional Limits and Separation Times for Two Interacting Elephant Random Walks
summary: We establish functional scaling limits and study first separation times for the interacting two elephant model studied by Aguech and Qin. In the joint diffusive regime, we give a direct martingale proof of convergence to a two-dimensional continuous Gaussian process represented by a matrix-kernel analogue of the noise-reinforced Brownian motion. We then investigate the difference process, whose diffusive scaling persists in the symmetric case even when the joint walk is critical or superdiffusive.
